author: HorizonTuner · Bagley as Codex
description: R34 / V-spec tachometer layout adaptation with a Nür 300 kmh speed face, fixed boost and four-wheel average tire-temperature auxiliaries, and five NISMO MFD Ver.II-inspired pages. Speed is intentionally fixed to kmh regardless of global mph settings. Original core-dial artwork; unavailable telemetry stays N/A. Change pages in HUD Advanced Settings.
